issues.description: The problem statement explicitly instructs students not to rename columns with AS unless requested, but the reference solution for Aufgabe 04 uses an alias ('regierungsbezirk AS District'). This contradicts the instruction and may confuse students about whether aliases are permitted or expected.
issues.suggestedFix: Either remove the alias in the reference solution (change 'SELECT regierungsbezirk AS District, ...' to 'SELECT regierungsbezirk, ...') so it follows the 'no AS' instruction, or update the problem statement to explicitly allow/require aliases and ensure the tests accept the aliased column name.

issues.description: The solution query in aufgabe04.sql renames the column regierungsbezirk to the English alias 'District' (SELECT regierungsbezirk AS District). The problem statement and task text refer to the concept as 'Regierungsbezirk' (German). This introduces a cross-artifact naming mismatch and contradicts the explicit instruction not to rename columns with AS unless requested, potentially confusing students about which column name is expected.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the alias and keep the original column name: SELECT regierungsbezirk, SUM(einwohner_w), SUM(einwohner_m) ... GROUP BY regierungsbezirk. This preserves the naming used in the problem statement and avoids introducing an unexpected English identifier.
